;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Sectarianism in Pakistan]]
**[[Islamic militants]] attack [[Christianity in Pakistan|Christian]] sections of [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], leaving 13 dead in the city of [[Mardan]]. [http://edition.cnn.com/2016/09/02/asia/pakistan-christian-neighborhood-attack/ (CNN)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[President of Colombia]] [[Juan Manuel Santos]] announces that he will sign the peace deal with the [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia]] or FARC on September 26. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/57c8920711be48d1a06069125710b1e8/santos-colombian-sides-sign-peace-deal-late-september (AP)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2016 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Residents of the American state of [[Florida]] prepare for the impact of [[Hurricane Hermine]] which is expected to make landfall today. A state of emergency has been declared in 51 of the 67 counties in the state. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-09-02/hermine-florida-braces-for-first-hurricane-in-more-than-a-decade/7807488 (Reuters/AFP via ABC News Australia)]
*An [[2016 Davao City explosion|explosion at a night market in Davao City]], Philippines kills at least 14 people and injures 60. President of the Philippines [[Rodrigo Duterte]] was in the city at the time. He is the former mayor of [[Davao City]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-blast-idUSKCN11824W (Reuters)], [http://news.abs-cbn.com/news/09/02/16/davao-blast-death-toll-rises-to-14-67-others-hurt (ABS-CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[President of Uzbekistan|President]] [[Islam Karimov]] of [[Uzbekistan]] dies after 27 years in office. [http://time.com/4477252/uzbekistan-president-islam-karimov-ill/ (Reuters via ''Time'')] [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-37260375 (BBC)]
